newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED CLINCH ENGLISH LEAGUE TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED CLINCH ENGLISH LEAGUE TITLE.

text.p: Manchester United were crowned English premier league champions without kicking a ball on Tuesday as rivals Liverpool and Newcastle saw their hopes dashed by London opponents.
Second-placed Liverpool lost 2-1 at Wimbledon while Newcastle, the only other team with a chance of catching United, drew 0-0 at struggling West Ham.
The two results ensured Alex Ferguson's team would retain their title despite having two games still to play.
United have now won the premier league title four times in the past five seasons, the exception being 1994-95 when they finished runners-up to Blackburn.
